dataset.name: NSABP B-41 post-treatment residual-disease cohort (GSE275065)
dataset.description: Randomized phase III HER2-positive early breast-cancer subset with post-neoadjuvant residual-tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual event-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: GSE275065 releases 27 post-treatment residual-disease tumor profiles from NSABP B-41 participants who did not achieve pathological complete response in the breast. TRACE Explorer excludes one event recorded at zero follow-up, leaving 26 unique patients with positive event-free-survival time, seven events and 19 censored observations.
dataset.publication_citation: Fernandez-Martinez et al. Annals of Oncology 2025

metadata.source_program: NSABP B-41 randomized phase III trial NCT00486668
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Annals of Oncology
metadata.library_method: Ribo-Zero FFPE total RNA sequencing followed by STAR alignment, Salmon abundance estimation and source-defined fixed-upper-quartile normalization; TRACE Explorer applies log2(value + 1).
metadata.endpoint_context: Event-free survival among participants with residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant HER2-directed therapy
metadata.endpoint_definition_note: The pooled-analysis publication defines EFS from randomization to local, regional or distant recurrence, non-breast second primary cancer, contralateral invasive breast cancer or death from any cause. GEO releases exact individual EFS time in years and binary event status.
metadata.sample_selection_note: All 27 GEO profiles are source-designated post-treatment residual-disease tumors and map one-to-one to the public matrix. The single zero-time event record GSM8464846 is excluded by the repository positive-time rule before analysis.
metadata.residual_disease_caveat: The cohort is conditional on residual disease at surgery and cannot be generalized to trial participants who achieved pathological complete response. The 27-profile release is also a selected molecular subset of the 97 NSABP B-41 participants with residual disease reported in the pooled study.
metadata.source_metadata_caveat: The accession title, POST matrix filename, pcr breast=RD field, treated-tumor fields and linked publication identify post-treatment residual tumors. A boilerplate GEO extraction-protocol sentence says baseline tumor samples and conflicts with those source-designating fields; TRACE Explorer records the inconsistency rather than silently treating the samples as pretreatment.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The linked article states that Salmon gene counts were normalized to a fixed upper quartile before log2 transformation. The public matrix contains 58,387 unique source symbols and unlogged nonnegative normalized values; TRACE Explorer applies only the documented log2(value + 1) transform.
metadata.controlled_access_note: Raw FASTQ files and the broader NSABP B-41 clinical dataset are controlled under dbGaP phs003275.v2.p1. The exact processed matrix and individual EFS fields used for this 27-profile release are public in GEO.
metadata.overlap_note: GSE275065 is external to TCGA-BRCA. It is the post-treatment residual-disease subset related to the 245-profile pretreatment GSE234519 release; GSE234519 is not imported because its individual endpoints remain controlled. No participant from either accession is pooled with another TRACE Explorer breast-cancer release.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms pinned GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled and NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: One source-designated residual invasive breast tumor per participant after neoadjuvant HER2-directed therapy

expression.label: GEO fixed-upper-quartile-normalized Salmon counts transformed as log2(value + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GEO GSE275065 source gene-symbol row labels
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The pinned source matrix has no case-insensitively duplicated feature symbols.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer applies the log2(value + 1) step documented by the linked publication to source values already normalized to a fixed upper quartile. Values support within-cohort analysis and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Event-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: Local, regional or distant recurrence; non-breast second primary cancer; contralateral invasive breast cancer; or death from any cause
